tv_trade_start_intelligence_network = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			has_variable = tv_trade_selected_intelligence_market
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_intelligence_active_market }
			tv_grand_merchant_available_for_commercial_intelligence_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					has_variable = tv_trade_selected_intelligence_market
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_intelligence_active_market value = var:tv_trade_selected_intelligence_market }
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_commercial_intelligence_active value = 1 }
				tv_trade_league_refresh_intelligence_members_display_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_start_chain = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			has_variable = tv_grand_merchant_char
			var:tv_grand_merchant_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			has_variable = tv_grand_merchant_char
			var:tv_grand_merchant_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_chain_active }
			tv_grand_merchant_available_for_trade_chain_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_chain_origin_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_chain_origin_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_chain_destination_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_chain_destination_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			in_trade_range_of = scope:actor
			location = {
				distance_to_squared = {
					location = scope:target.location
					value >= 150000
				}
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			in_trade_range_of = scope:actor
			location = {
				distance_to_squared = {
					location = scope:target.location
					value >= 150000
				}
			}
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_chain_origin_location_scope }
			}
			scope:target_1 = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_chain_destination_location_scope }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						has_variable = tv_grand_merchant_char
						var:tv_grand_merchant_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_chain_active }
						tv_grand_merchant_available_for_trade_chain_trigger = yes
						scope:tv_trade_chain_origin_location_scope = {
							distance_to_squared = {
								location = scope:tv_trade_chain_destination_location_scope
								value >= 150000
							}
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_active value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_origin_location value = scope:tv_trade_chain_origin_location_scope }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_destination_location value = scope:tv_trade_chain_destination_location_scope }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_distance_sq value = { value = "scope:tv_trade_chain_origin_location_scope.distance_to_squared(scope:tv_trade_chain_destination_location_scope)" } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_valid value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_status value = 1 }
					tv_trade_league_refresh_trade_chain_effect = yes
					tv_trade_league_refresh_trade_chain_members_display_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
